title: Aero 14 Laptop
text: Lightweight 14-inch laptop with 16 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD and up to 14 hours of battery life. Weighs 1.2 kg.

title: Titan 16 Pro Laptop
text: 16-inch performance laptop with 32 GB RAM, 1 TB SSD and a dedicated graphics card for gaming and video editing.

title: Pulse ANC Headphones
text: Over-ear wireless headphones with active noise cancelling, 30 hours of battery and USB-C fast charging.

title: Pulse Buds
text: True wireless earbuds, water resistant (IPX5), 8 hours of playback plus 24 hours with the charging case.

title: Vista 27 4K Monitor
text: 27-inch 4K IPS monitor with USB-C power delivery (65 W), height-adjustable stand and 99% sRGB coverage.

title: KeyFlow Mechanical Keyboard
text: Low-profile mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable switches, Bluetooth for up to 3 devices and backlight.

title: Glide Ergonomic Mouse
text: Ergonomic vertical wireless mouse with silent clicks and a rechargeable battery that lasts 70 days.

title: Dock X USB-C Hub
text: 11-in-1 USB-C dock with two HDMI 4K outputs, Ethernet, SD card reader and 100 W pass-through charging.

title: Orbit 4K Webcam
text: 4K webcam with autofocus, dual noise-reducing microphones and a privacy shutter.

title: Shipping policy
text: Orders ship within 24 hours on business days. Standard delivery takes 2-4 business days and is free for orders over 50 EUR. Express delivery (next business day) costs 9.90 EUR.

title: Returns and refunds
text: You can return any product within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be in their original packaging. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days.

title: Warranty and repairs
text: Every product includes a manufacturer warranty (1 to 3 years depending on the product). To open a repair, contact support with your order number. Accidental damage is not covered.

title: Payment methods
text: We accept Visa, Mastercard, PayPal and bank transfer. Orders over 300 EUR can be paid in 3 interest-free installments.

title: Customer support hours
text: Customer support is available Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00 CET, by chat or at support@nimbus.example.
